evals.prompt: Ingest these three bundles: course, exercise sheet, and corrections.
evals.expected_output: Read all sources, choose coherent boundaries and evidence-backed cross-source matches, use distinct source IDs, check a concrete plan without writes, and obtain approval before materialization.

evals.prompt: Ingest one mixed bundle containing course material, questions, and answers.
evals.expected_output: Do not classify the whole bundle by filename. Select every source line exactly once; keep context, formulas, figures, and proofs together. Course and section notes share courses/ with meaningful names.

evals.prompt: The course has no exercises. Make it a complete course.
evals.expected_output: Preserve only supplied course material. Explain that missing exercises/corrections belong to Enrich, not this skill. Do not create learning material or HTML.

evals.prompt: These answers have ambiguous numbering. Link them to the most likely questions.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the answers but do not guess links. Add explicit ambiguity issues and show them in the approval plan.

evals.prompt: I approved the checked plan, but the source Markdown changed before execution.
evals.expected_output: Stop on changed fingerprints, inspect again, and obtain fresh approval for a revised plan. Do not silently update the hash.

evals.prompt: The destination already contains notes. Replace it.
evals.expected_output: Report that existing targets cannot be reused by this version. Do not delete or overwrite; request a new target or a separately scoped user decision.

evals.prompt: The approved write failed. Clean up and try again.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the incomplete root, show the exact error/path, and require separate scoped deletion permission. Do not delete original bundles or retry into existing output.

evals.prompt: Two selected bundles have the same PDF and figure filenames.
evals.expected_output: Choose distinct source IDs under sources/, put each PDF beside document.md without an inner source/ directory, keep copies/links independent, and include those paths in the reviewed plan.

evals.prompt: I previously approved an earlier ingest plan. Use that hash with the updated skill and simplify my existing output in place.
evals.expected_output: Do not reuse stale approval, guess a plan upgrade, or modify existing output. Confirm contextual placement, check a version-2 plan for output version 3, show flattened source paths, page links, and new hash, obtain approval, and create a new destination from unchanged original Import bundles without PDF reconversion.

evals.prompt: Infer all prerequisite skills while ingesting.
evals.expected_output: Keep inference out of Ingest. Only add source-evidenced course/exercise/correction and earlier-question relationships. Defer competency notes and prerequisite inference to Enrich.

evals.prompt: Ingest this PT algebra bundle into my existing vault. Comparable chapters live under courses/PT/maths.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the identified vault and representative note metadata/content, confirm matching source context, propose the appropriate existing container and exact new chapter destination with rationale, ask for placement confirmation, then separately check and seek approval of the detailed plan. Never silently place the chapter at the vault root.

evals.prompt: My vault uses Mathematiques/PT and Mathematiques/PTSI. This import has no clear level.
evals.expected_output: Respect the existing hierarchy rather than impose courses/PT/maths. Ask a focused level/placement question, review bounded inventory omissions with targeted inspection, and obtain confirmation instead of guessing a level or falling back to the vault root.

evals.prompt: There is no suitable mathematics container yet. Ingest this chapter.
evals.expected_output: Propose the exact new hierarchy and chapter destination with rationale, explicitly confirm parent creation, record placement.create_parent only after approval, show exact create_directories in the read-only checked plan, and obtain final write approval. Shared containers are never automatically removed.

evals.prompt: My exercise spans original PDF pages 2 and 4; the printed labels are 10 and 12. Make the source links useful.
evals.expected_output: Generated provenance uses separate retained-PDF links with #page=2 and #page=4, never printed labels or #page=2-4. Index links target the first imported page. Preserve author-authored links and byte-identical retained Markdown.

evals.prompt: I confirmed where it belongs. Write the chapter now.
evals.expected_output: Placement confirmation alone does not authorize writing. Show the detailed checked plan, files, any new parent directories, evidence, issues, execution command, and hash; ask for explicit final approval.

evals.prompt: Place the new exercise ingest inside an earlier generated chapter.
evals.expected_output: Do not add files inside another ingest's owned subtree or overwrite its notes. Propose a suitable sibling destination, explain this iteration does not merge or cross-link ingests, and obtain placement and plan confirmation.

evals.prompt: The course was split but this sheet has 33 exercise headings and still only one exercise/correction note. Redo the splitting.
evals.expected_output: Read all selected course, exercise, and correction content. Propose one note per actual exercise and supplied correction unit, with subquestions/answers anchored inside, not per-question files. Check all roles and show source-unit ownership/counts; do not repair data or reuse a destination without the separately required approvals.

evals.prompt: For granular HTML, make a separate exercise note for every numbered question.
evals.expected_output: Keep each exercise and its correction unit intact. Use internal anchored blocks for finer HTML, preserve source hierarchy/context, and explain that Enrich preserves units and Generate groups by exercise identity. The checker rejects question/answer-per-note fragmentation.

evals.prompt: Keep all six numbered course subtopics in one note because their heading depths differ. Add a generic exception for everything.
evals.expected_output: Review numbered peers independently of Markdown depth. Split coherent topics or provide an exact note/source/family-scoped grouping reason based on the passages. Reject blanket waivers; expose all reviewed scopes before approval.

evals.prompt: The correction labels are shifted by one; pair the lists by position and fix their numbers.
evals.expected_output: Preserve printed labels and match supplied statements/reasoning with source evidence. Do not zip inventories, change source text, or fabricate missing targets. Show unresolved matches explicitly.

evals.prompt: Two real exercise headings are inside one protected blockquote. Override the checker and put them in one exercise note.
evals.expected_output: Do not corrupt protected syntax or waive real exercise aggregation. Report the unsafe boundary and ask a focused source-specific question. A misleading-candidate exception is only for an actually misleading candidate, not a way to bypass the unit contract.
